svg.title: OpenCode Go pace sidebar showing behind-pace, ahead-of-pace, and critical monthly bars
svg.desc: Terminal-style screenshot of the OpenCode Go sidebar in pace mode, captured from a 64 by 4 character frame rendered with fake usage data. The 3 visible rows read: 5-hour window 25% ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━───────── Weekly 95% ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━── Monthly 100% ✖ limit reached ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
